./mhw mcp check [--timeout=SECONDS] connection test: start each MCP active-set server and say whether
                                          it answers (it starts processes; exit 1 when one fails; #219,

    ./mhw mcp render --check            drift check: exit 1 when an installed MCP configuration differs
                                          from the definition; it starts nothing (mhw mcp render --help)
why: A break of the public interface (#595, v11, section 4 of the CLI native baseline PRD): `mhw status --mcp-connect[=SECONDS]` is removed, because the connection test starts processes and status never does. The usage text drops its two lines and names `mhw mcp check [--timeout=SECONDS]` (the connection test) and `mhw mcp render --check` (the drift check) in their place, so the help tells the two apart. Every other line is compared unchanged.

Left out of the comparison on both sides until the base holds it; test/hooks/pattern-check-install.test.js holds those files.
